text:
pagerduty-bot: HIGH: embeddings.edge /v1/embeddings is seeing sustained 7.8k req/min from ~4200 distinct IPs over last 3m — anomaly score 0.98. Possible scraper farm. https://monitoring/redwood/incidents/6141592653 :rotating_light:

olivia (oncall): seeing it on the dashboard, tail latency up ~220ms p95, token cost spike. paging now. taking lead. @raj you up?

raj (eng-sre): on it. quick triage: top source countries are CN/ID/IN, most requests use same UA string "EmbedCruncher/1.0". sessions look short-lived. suspect credentialless scraper hitting batch embeddings.

anya (security): recommend temp WAF rule to block that UA + geo slice, and enable signature-based tarpit on matching IPs. Also suggest adding a challenge for suspicious clients.

olivia (oncall): agreed. mitigation plan: 1) apply WAF UA block for "EmbedCruncher/1.0" (low risk) 2) apply geo rate-slice for CN/ID 3) reduce embeddings max_concurrency for public tier by 30% 4) disable async batch processing for 15m if surge continues. Any objections? :eyes:

raj (eng-sre): no objections. executing step 1 now.

raj (eng-sre): (code)
---
# waf rule payload
{
  "name": "block-embedcruncher-ua",
  "match": {"http.user_agent": "EmbedCruncher/1.0"},
  "action": "block",
  "ttl": 900
}
---
posting to WAF API.

pagerduty-bot: WAF change queued by raj, change-id CW-8821, expected deploy 12s.

raj (eng-sre): WAF rule deployed. seeing ~42% of offending traffic drop immediately.

anya (security): good. enabling tarpit for remaining top 600 IPs. tarpit will slow responses to 10s and drop keepalives.

raj (eng-sre): tarpit applied. observed synthetic logs:
---
[6141592660] src=203.0.113.45 ua=EmbedCruncher/1.0 status=200 lat=9980ms
[6141592664] src=203.0.113.46 ua=EmbedCruncher/1.0 status=504 lat=10020ms
---
those hits are getting slowed, overall QPS back to ~3.1k.

olivia (oncall): good progress. marco, any customers on public embeddings we need to notify?

marco (product): quick check shows two smaller SaaS customers with high embed usage in APAC. No revenue-critical customers impacted so far, but support may see a spike. Let's draft a short notice if we need to throttle harder.

dave (support): prepping a canned answer: "We're seeing an automated abuse event impacting embeddings in APAC. We've applied temporary rate controls and are monitoring — if you see degraded embeddings please DM us and we'll investigate."

raj (eng-sre): still seeing some traffic morphing UA. pushing a dynamic quota slice on anonymous/public API keys to cap per-key RPS at 0.8 for 10m. Command: (shell)
---
curl -X POST https://internal-api/config/quota/slice \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"selector":"public_key:*","rps":0.8,"duration":600}'
---

olivia (oncall): applied. early telemetry shows per-key hotspots decreasing.

anya (security): Recommend we keep WAF block and quota slice for 30m and then reassess. Also collecting IPs for long-term blacklisting and sharing with threat intel.

marco (product): please flag if any paid customers see >10% error or latency regression; we'll consider a brief proactive message.

raj (eng-sre): rolling back batch endpoint (async embeddings) toggle to disabled for public tier for 20m — this will reduce aggregation surface for scrapers.

olivia (oncall): update status: mitigation actions deployed (WAF block, tarpit, per-key quota slice, disabled async batching). Overall QPS from suspicious cohort down 86%. P95 latency back to normal for non-suspect traffic.

dave (support): posting incident note to #support-status with current mitigations and expected next update in 30m.

anyone: need followups?

anya (security): capture sample request headers and IP ranges, push to threat intel. Also start rules for UA fuzzing — scrapers are changing UA strings quickly.

raj (eng-sre): agree. creating a short-term heuristic: block if UA matches /Embed.*(Crunch|Scrape)/i OR if rps_from_ip>50 AND requests_per_min>120 for 3m. I'll paste rule after testing.

olivia (oncall): handing incident to night oncall at 6141592700, leaving notes in the incident doc. If things degrade, escalate to SEV team.

pagerduty-bot: handoff: olivia -> tom (oncall-night). Incident severity reduced to P2. Next update scheduled 30m. :white_check_mark:
